description:
About 90 of reddit.cr's 363 lines are dedicated to JSON parsing:

- `parse_reddit_response`
- `extract_children`
- `parse_reddit_post`
- `extract_post_data` + the `PostData` record
- `extract_title`, `extract_permalink`, `build_discussion_url`, `determine_effective_url`, `extract_pub_date`

None of these methods touch the network, OAuth, caching, or response-status handling — they're pure JSON-shape adapters. They share no state with the fetch path.

Move them to `src/fetcher/reddit_json_parser.cr` (note: there's already a `reddit_json_parser.cr` for the older non-OAuth path; pick a non-clashing name like `reddit_post_parser.cr` or co-locate them). Define `Fetcher::Reddit::PostParser` (or `Fetcher::RedditPostParser`) that owns these methods and exposes a single `parse(body : String, limit : Int32) : Array(Entry)` entry point.

Why:
- Single responsibility: reddit.cr becomes the fetch/coordinator, the new file owns shape parsing.
- Easier to swap parsing strategy (streaming vs DOM) without touching fetch code.
- Smaller surface to unit-test.

Acceptance:
- New file exists; the listed methods live only there.
- `parse_reddit_response` becomes a single delegation to the new module (or is removed entirely if no external caller).
- Specs pass.
title: Extract Reddit JSON parsing into its own file
